"""Exact source-gated Native entrypoint for C111706 U-turn deliveries."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ASSIGNMENT = "testing__C111706__NRS-484B-403-3__motor_vehicle_driver"
SUFFIXES = ("intersection_vehicle_near", "approach_before_intersection",
            "intersection_vehicle_far")
CASES = {ASSIGNMENT + "__" + suffix for suffix in SUFFIXES}


def check(root=ROOT):
    root = Path(root)
    config = json.loads((root / "config.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if (config.get("assignment_id"), config.get("law_id"),
            config.get("cell_id"), config.get("actor")) != (
            ASSIGNMENT, "NRS-484B-403-3", "C111706", "motor_vehicle_driver"):
        raise ValueError("wrong exact U-turn package identity")
    selected = config.get("selected_case_id")
    if selected not in CASES or set(config.get("supported_case_ids", [])) != CASES:
        raise ValueError("exact U-turn case selection differs")
    if (config.get("rate_hz"), config.get("duration_s"),
            config.get("frame_count")) != (20, 45, 900):
        raise ValueError("exact U-turn capture timebase differs")
    cameras = config.get("cameras", [])
    if [(c.get("name"), c.get("width"), c.get("height")) for c in cameras] != [
            ("overview", 1920, 1080), ("approach", 1280, 720),
            ("reference_corner", 1280, 720),
            ("driver_reference", 1280, 720)]:
        raise ValueError("four original cameras required")
    return selected


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1")
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=2000)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    selected = check()
    if args.check:
        return 0
    if args.output_dir is None:
        raise ValueError("new Native output directory required")
    site_root = os.environ.get("C111706_SITE_ROOT")
    if not site_root:
        raise ValueError("C111706_SITE_ROOT reviewed site directory required")
    site_path = Path(site_root) / (selected.split("__")[-1] + ".json")
    if not site_path.is_file() or site_path.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError("exact reviewed site packet required")
    from live_entrypoint import run
    run(host=args.host, port=args.port, site_path=site_path,
        case_id=selected, output=args.output_dir / "capture" / "native-uturn.json")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Saved U-turn finalizer; diagnostic inputs never assert physical or legal success."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from native_uturn import analyze_native


VIEWS = ("overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference")


def required(root: Path, relative: str) -> Path:
    path = root / relative
    if not path.is_file() or path.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError("Missing required source: " + relative)
    return path


def digest(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def read(path: Path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def write(path: Path, value):
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def measure_uturn(measured: dict, site: dict) -> dict:
    """Report source measurements without applying a legal U-turn predicate."""
    return {"reversal_deg": measured["reversal_deg"],
            "whole_body_inside_intersection_frames":
                measured["whole_body_inside_intersection_frames"],
            "minimum_other_vehicle_center_distance_m":
                measured["minimum_other_vehicle_center_distance_m"],
            "district_review_source_sha256": site["district_source_sha256"],
            "intersection_boundary_source_sha256":
                measured["intersection_boundary_source_sha256"],
            "statutory_district_classification": "unresolved_review",
            "physical_completion": "unconfirmed"}


def source(root: Path):
    index_path = required(root, "capture/source-index.json")
    index = read(index_path)
    if index.get("format") not in (
            "c111706-diagnostic-source-index-v1",
            "c111706-native-source-index-v1"):
        raise ValueError("U-turn source index format differs")
    case = read(required(root, "config.json"))["selected_case_id"]
    if index.get("case_id") != case:
        raise ValueError("U-turn source index case differs")
    diagnostic = index["format"] == "c111706-diagnostic-source-index-v1"
    sources = {}
    for name in ("site.json", "native-uturn.json"):
        rel = "capture/" + name
        path = required(root, rel)
        item = index.get("files", {}).get(name, {})
        if (item.get("sha256") != digest(path) or
                item.get("source") != ("diagnostic_synthetic" if diagnostic else "native_original")):
            raise ValueError("U-turn original source binding differs: " + name)
        sources[name] = path
    site = read(sources["site.json"])
    native = read(sources["native-uturn.json"])
    if site.get("case_id") != case or native.get("case_id") != case:
        raise ValueError("U-turn exact site/Native case differs")
    if native.get("site_sha256") != digest(sources["site.json"]):
        raise ValueError("U-turn site/Native source join differs")
    if (native.get("map_sha256") != site.get("map_sha256") or
            native.get("route_sha256") != site.get("route_sha256") or
            native.get("district_basis", {}).get("source_sha256") != site.get("district_source_sha256") or
            native.get("intersection_boundary") != site.get("intersection_boundary")):
        raise ValueError("U-turn map, route, district or boundary source differs")
    if not diagnostic and site.get("source_kind") != "original_native_site_review":
        raise ValueError("original reviewed U-turn site required")
    measured = analyze_native(sources["native-uturn.json"],
                              expected_case=case,
                              expected_sha256=digest(sources["native-uturn.json"]))
    expected_count = 9 if diagnostic else 900
    if measured["frame_count"] != expected_count:
        raise ValueError("U-turn source frame count differs")
    inside = bool(measured["whole_body_inside_intersection_frames"])
    if inside == case.endswith("__approach_before_intersection"):
        raise ValueError("measured U-turn location differs from exact case")
    return index, site, native, measured, sources, diagnostic


def build_report(root: Path):
    root = Path(root).resolve()
    index, site, native, measured, sources, diagnostic = source(root)
    case = index["case_id"]
    selected = {"uturn_source_measurement": {
        "method": "measure_uturn", "value": measure_uturn(measured, site),
        "sources": {"capture/site.json": digest(sources["site.json"]),
                    "capture/native-uturn.json": digest(sources["native-uturn.json"])}}}
    return {"format": "worker-analysis-report", "case_id": case,
            "analysis_complete": True, "measurements": selected,
            "source_index_sha256": digest(root / "capture/source-index.json"),
            "provenance_kind": "synthetic_fixture" if diagnostic else "original_saved_source",
            "diagnostic_fixture": diagnostic,
            "legal_verdict_claimed": False, "physical_acceptance_claimed": False,
            "limitations": ["Business-district and statutory intersection classification remain independent review.",
                            "Sampled body containment does not establish continuous swept occupancy.",
                            "CARLA physical motion and original pixels require independent review."]}


def build_result(root: Path, report: dict):
    """Retain the exact source-frame join for the pinned converter and media audit."""
    root = Path(root).resolve()
    config = read(required(root, "config.json"))
    index, site, native, measured, sources, diagnostic = source(root)
    frames = native["frames"]
    count = len(frames)
    trace_path = required(root, "trace.jsonl")
    frame_map_path = required(root, "video_frames.jsonl")
    trace = [json.loads(line) for line in trace_path.read_text().splitlines()]
    frame_map = [json.loads(line) for line in frame_map_path.read_text().splitlines()]
    if len(trace) != count or len(frame_map) != count:
        raise ValueError("U-turn trace/video source frame count differs")
    if [r["frame"] for r in trace] != [f["frame"] for f in frames] or [
            r["carla_frame"] for r in frame_map] != [f["frame"] for f in frames]:
        raise ValueError("U-turn original frame join differs")
    for name in VIEWS:
        required(root, name + ".mkv")
    description = config["case"]["recording_description"]
    context = site
    values = {
        "business_district": lambda frame: {"district_source_sha256": site["district_source_sha256"],
                                             "classification": "unresolved_review"},
        "intersection_exception": lambda frame: {"boundary_source_sha256": site["intersection_boundary_source_sha256"],
                                                   "ego_body_corners_xy_m": frame["ego"]["body_corners_xy_m"]},
        "vehicle_reversal": lambda frame: {"ego_yaw_deg": frame["ego"]["yaw_deg"],
                                             "ego_lane_id": frame["ego"]["lane_id"]},
        "surrounding_vehicle": lambda frame: {"other_vehicle": frame["other_vehicle"],
                                                "ego": {"x": frame["ego"]["x"], "y": frame["ego"]["y"]}},
        "camera_frame_map": lambda frame: {"native_frame": frame["frame"],
                                            "camera_views": list(VIEWS)},
    }
    evidence = []
    for number, channel in enumerate(description["channels"]):
        name = channel["name"]
        if name not in values:
            raise ValueError("unimplemented U-turn recording channel: " + name)
        reference = f"recording-channel-{number}.jsonl"
        with (root / reference).open("w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
            for frame in frames:
                stream.write(json.dumps({"time_s": frame["time_s"],
                                         "value": values[name](frame)}) + "\n")
        evidence.append({"name": name, "unit": channel["unit"],
                         "reference": reference})
    for number, item in enumerate(description["context_inputs"]):
        if item["name"] != "reviewed_original_site":
            raise ValueError("unimplemented U-turn recording context")
        reference = f"recording-context-{number}.json"
        write(root / reference, {item["name"]: context})
        evidence.append({"name": item["name"], "unit": item["unit"],
                         "reference": reference})
    result = {"case_id": report["case_id"],
              "measured_values": {key: value["value"] for key, value in report["measurements"].items()},
              "target_checks": [{"target": "source_sealed_observation_count",
                                  "requested": count, "measured": count,
                                  "method": "original frame and video join", "tolerance": 0,
                                  "matched": True, "physical_cause_confirmed": False,
                                  "cause_evidence": "original physical realization unverified"}],
              "setup_confirmed": False, "behavior_attempted": False,
              "maneuver_completed": False,
              "termination_reason": "saved source processing; physical completion unverified",
              "physical_failure_flags": ["physical_completion_unverified"],
              "trace_reference": "trace.jsonl",
              "video_references": [name + ".mkv" for name in VIEWS],
              "video_frame_map_reference": "video_frames.jsonl",
              "recording_description": description,
              "recording_evidence": evidence, "realized_observables": {},
              "provenance_kind": report["provenance_kind"],
              "diagnostic_fixture": diagnostic,
              "legal_verdict_claimed": False,
              "physical_acceptance_claimed": False}
    if (root / "result.json").exists():
        raise ValueError("Retain prior result; use a fresh analysis attempt")
    write(root / "result.json", result)
    return result


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--attempt", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    report = build_report(args.attempt)
    build_result(args.attempt, report)
    write(args.output, report)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Owned CARLA lifecycle for one source-reviewed exact U-turn case.

The caller supplies original spawn/camera transforms and a sensor builder. No
map geometry, business-district classification, or physical success is inferred.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from copy import copy
from pathlib import Path
import sys

from capture_cameras import OriginalCameraCollector, VIEWS
from capture_uturn import capture
from construct import construct, load_site
from control_uturn import RouteFollower, TimedOtherVehicle


def run_exact(world, *, site_path: Path, site_sha256: str, case_id: str,
              ego_spawn, other_spawn, camera_builder, output: Path,
              control_factory, capture_fn=capture) -> dict:
    """Run one exact case and restore world/owned actors even on readback failure.

    ``camera_builder(world, actors, site)`` must return four named CARLA sensor
    actors already configured to the declared dimensions. All source selection
    and physical review happen before this function is invoked.
    """
    site = load_site(site_path, site_sha256, expected_case=case_id)
    if not callable(camera_builder) or not callable(control_factory):
        raise ValueError("camera and control factories required")
    if not site.get("route_sha256") or not site.get("intersection_boundary", {}).get("source_sha256"):
        raise ValueError("original route and boundary sources required")
    if not isinstance(output, Path) or output.exists():
        raise ValueError("new exact Native output path required")
    original_settings = copy(world.get_settings())
    owned = None
    sensors = {}
    try:
        settings = copy(original_settings)
        settings.synchronous_mode = True
        settings.fixed_delta_seconds = 0.05
        world.apply_settings(settings)
        owned = construct(world, site, ego_spawn=ego_spawn, other_spawn=other_spawn)
        sensors = camera_builder(world, owned, site)
        if set(sensors) != set(VIEWS) or len({sensor.id for sensor in sensors.values()}) != 4:
            raise ValueError("four distinct original camera actors required")
        camera_root = output.parent / "camera-originals"
        if camera_root.exists():
            raise ValueError("new camera-originals directory required")
        collector = OriginalCameraCollector(camera_root, sensors)
        ego_control = RouteFollower(owned["ego_route"], control_factory, arrival_radius_m=1.5)
        other_follow = RouteFollower(owned["other_route"], control_factory, arrival_radius_m=1.5)
        other_control = TimedOtherVehicle(other_follow, site["other_start_tick"])
        def brake(actor):
            actor.apply_control(control_factory(throttle=0.0, steer=0.0, brake=1.0))
        receipt = capture_fn(world, owned["ego"], owned["other_vehicle"],
                             site_path, site_sha256, case_id, output,
                             ego_control, other_control, brake,
                             ticks=900, step_s=0.05, camera_collector=collector)
        return {**receipt, "camera_manifest": str(camera_root / "camera-manifest.json")}
    finally:
        cleanup_errors = []
        for sensor in sensors.values():
            for method in (sensor.stop, sensor.destroy):
                try:
                    method()
                except Exception as exc:
                    cleanup_errors.append(exc)
        if owned is not None:
            for actor in (owned["other_vehicle"], owned["ego"]):
                try:
                    actor.apply_control(control_factory(throttle=0.0, steer=0.0, brake=1.0))
                except Exception as exc:
                    cleanup_errors.append(exc)
                try:
                    actor.destroy()
                except Exception as exc:
                    cleanup_errors.append(exc)
        try:
            world.apply_settings(original_settings)
        except Exception as exc:
            cleanup_errors.append(exc)
        if cleanup_errors and sys.exc_info()[0] is None:
            raise RuntimeError("exact-case cleanup failed") from cleanup_errors[0]

"""Lazy CARLA construction for the assigned intersection U-turn cell.

The caller supplies a source-reviewed site and transforms from original map
survey. No actor is moved by teleportation after construction.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path


class ConstructionError(ValueError):
    pass


def _require(value, message):
    if not value:
        raise ConstructionError(message)


def load_site(path: Path, expected_sha256: str, *, expected_case: str) -> dict:
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    _require(hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == expected_sha256, "site source hash mismatch")
    site = json.loads(raw)
    _require(site.get("case_id") == expected_case, "case identity mismatch")
    _require(site.get("map_sha256") and site.get("district_source_sha256"), "map or district source missing")
    _require(site.get("intersection_boundary_source_sha256"), "intersection boundary source missing")
    route = site.get("ego_route", [])
    _require(len(route) >= 3, "U-turn route too short")
    _require(route[0]["road_id"] == route[-1]["road_id"], "U-turn road mismatch")
    _require(route[0]["lane_id"] != route[-1]["lane_id"], "opposite lane missing")
    in_junction = any(p.get("junction_id") is not None for p in route)
    outside_case = expected_case.endswith("__approach_before_intersection")
    _require(in_junction != outside_case, "route intersection occupancy mismatches case")
    _require(site.get("ego_blueprint", "").startswith("vehicle."), "ego blueprint missing")
    _require(site.get("other_blueprint", "").startswith("vehicle."), "other vehicle blueprint missing")
    _require(site.get("other_route") and site.get("other_spawn"), "other vehicle route/spawn missing")
    return site


def construct(world, site: dict, *, ego_spawn, other_spawn):
    """Spawn both actors; return owned actors and reviewed route definitions.

    CARLA setup ownership stays with the caller, which must destroy both actors
    and restore world settings in a guaranteed cleanup block.
    """
    map_name = world.get_map().name
    _require(map_name == site["map_name"], "wrong live map")
    library = world.get_blueprint_library()
    ego_bp = library.find(site["ego_blueprint"])
    other_bp = library.find(site["other_blueprint"])
    ego = world.try_spawn_actor(ego_bp, ego_spawn)
    _require(ego is not None, "ego spawn failed")
    try:
        other = world.try_spawn_actor(other_bp, other_spawn)
        _require(other is not None, "other vehicle spawn failed")
    except Exception:
        ego.destroy()
        raise
    return {"ego": ego, "other_vehicle": other,
            "ego_route": site["ego_route"], "other_route": site["other_route"]}

"""Lazy, source-route vehicle controls for the 20 Hz intersection U-turn.

The route is a reviewed physical construction target. Controls are requests;
completion and legal context must be checked from original capture afterward.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import math


class ControlError(ValueError):
    pass


def _need(ok, message):
    if not ok:
        raise ControlError(message)


def _finite(value):
    return isinstance(value, (float, int)) and math.isfinite(value)


def validate_route(points, *, expected_start_road=None):
    """Reject disconnected or malformed authored route samples before driving."""
    _need(isinstance(points, list) and len(points) >= 3, "route needs at least three samples")
    for index, point in enumerate(points):
        _need(all(_finite(point.get(key)) for key in ("x", "y", "target_speed_mps")),
              "route point missing finite position or speed")
        _need(0 < point["target_speed_mps"] <= 20, "route target speed outside controller range")
        _need(point.get("road_id") is not None and point.get("lane_id") is not None,
              "route lane identity missing")
        if index:
            distance = math.hypot(point["x"] - points[index - 1]["x"],
                                  point["y"] - points[index - 1]["y"])
            _need(0.15 <= distance <= 8, "route samples disconnected or repeated")
    if expected_start_road is not None:
        _need(points[0]["road_id"] == expected_start_road, "wrong route starting road")
    return points


class RouteFollower:
    """Follow a reviewed polyline without teleporting or lane-autopilot recovery.

    ``control_factory`` creates the simulator's vehicle-control object from
    throttle, steer and brake. The caller owns actor/world setup and cleanup.
    """

    def __init__(self, route, control_factory, *, arrival_radius_m=1.2,
                 max_cross_track_m=4.0, wheelbase_m=2.7):
        self.route = validate_route(route)
        _need(callable(control_factory), "control factory missing")
        _need(0.2 <= arrival_radius_m <= 3, "invalid waypoint arrival radius")
        _need(1 <= max_cross_track_m <= 8, "invalid cross-track limit")
        _need(1.5 <= wheelbase_m <= 5, "invalid wheelbase")
        self.factory = control_factory
        self.arrival_radius_m = arrival_radius_m
        self.max_cross_track_m = max_cross_track_m
        self.wheelbase_m = wheelbase_m
        self.index = 1
        self.finished = False

    def __call__(self, actor, tick_index):
        _need(isinstance(tick_index, int) and tick_index >= 0, "invalid control tick")
        transform = actor.get_transform()
        x, y = float(transform.location.x), float(transform.location.y)
        yaw = math.radians(float(transform.rotation.yaw))
        _need(all(math.isfinite(v) for v in (x, y, yaw)), "invalid live ego pose")
        velocity = actor.get_velocity()
        speed = math.hypot(float(velocity.x), float(velocity.y))
        _need(math.isfinite(speed), "invalid live ego speed")
        if self.finished:
            actor.apply_control(self.factory(throttle=0.0, steer=0.0, brake=1.0))
            return
        # Only advance when the next route sample is actually reached. Never
        # jump ahead to a geographically nearby branch of a hairpin.
        target = self.route[self.index]
        distance = math.hypot(target["x"] - x, target["y"] - y)
        if distance <= self.arrival_radius_m:
            if self.index == len(self.route) - 1:
                self.finished = True
                actor.apply_control(self.factory(throttle=0.0, steer=0.0, brake=1.0))
                return
            self.index += 1
            target = self.route[self.index]
            distance = math.hypot(target["x"] - x, target["y"] - y)
        previous = self.route[self.index - 1]
        dx, dy = target["x"] - previous["x"], target["y"] - previous["y"]
        segment = math.hypot(dx, dy)
        cross_track = abs((x - previous["x"]) * dy - (y - previous["y"]) * dx) / segment
        _need(cross_track <= self.max_cross_track_m, "route tracking lost")
        heading = math.atan2(target["y"] - y, target["x"] - x)
        error = (heading - yaw + math.pi) % (2 * math.pi) - math.pi
        # Pure-pursuit curvature, expressed as a bounded steering request.
        curvature = 2 * math.sin(error) / max(distance, self.arrival_radius_m)
        steer = max(-1.0, min(1.0, math.atan(self.wheelbase_m * curvature) / .65))
        speed_error = target["target_speed_mps"] - speed
        throttle = max(0.0, min(.6, .28 * speed_error))
        brake = max(0.0, min(.7, -.28 * speed_error))
        actor.apply_control(self.factory(throttle=throttle, steer=steer, brake=brake))


class TimedOtherVehicle:
    """Hold then follow the same other-vehicle path in near/far cases."""

    def __init__(self, follower, start_tick):
        _need(isinstance(start_tick, int) and 0 <= start_tick < 900,
              "invalid other-vehicle start tick")
        self.follower = follower
        self.start_tick = start_tick

    def __call__(self, actor, tick_index):
        if tick_index < self.start_tick:
            actor.apply_control(self.follower.factory(throttle=0.0, steer=0.0, brake=1.0))
        else:
            self.follower(actor, tick_index - self.start_tick)

"""Original 20 Hz two-vehicle acquisition for the assigned U-turn cases.

The caller owns world synchrony, actor construction, cameras and restoration.
No CARLA import occurs here; the supplied world and actors are read directly.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path


class CaptureError(ValueError):
    pass


def _need(ok: bool, message: str) -> None:
    if not ok:
        raise CaptureError(message)


def _seal(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def _position(actor, road_map) -> dict:
    transform = actor.get_transform()
    loc = transform.location
    waypoint = road_map.get_waypoint(loc, project_to_road=False)
    _need(waypoint is not None, "original actor waypoint missing")
    corners = actor.bounding_box.get_world_vertices(transform)
    _need(len(corners) >= 4, "original body vertices missing")
    values = {
        "id": actor.id,
        "road_id": waypoint.road_id,
        "lane_id": waypoint.lane_id,
        "junction_id": waypoint.get_junction().id if waypoint.is_junction else None,
        "x": float(loc.x), "y": float(loc.y),
        "yaw_deg": float(transform.rotation.yaw),
        "body_corners_xy_m": [[float(vertex.x), float(vertex.y)] for vertex in corners],
    }
    _need(all(math.isfinite(v) for v in (values["x"], values["y"], values["yaw_deg"])),
          "nonfinite actor pose")
    _need(all(math.isfinite(v) for point in values["body_corners_xy_m"] for v in point),
          "nonfinite body vertex")
    return values


def capture(world, ego, other, site_path: Path, expected_site_sha256: str,
            expected_case: str, output: Path, ego_control, other_control, brake_control,
            *, ticks: int = 900, step_s: float = 0.05, camera_collector=None) -> dict:
    """Write a sealed projection only after all original ticks are acquired.

    Control callbacks receive (actor, tick_index) and must apply a control.
    The brake callback receives each actor and must apply full braking.
    They may implement an independently reviewed waypoint follower. A synthetic
    callback cannot establish physical completion. Pass the four-camera
    collector to join original sensor images to every world tick.
    """
    _need(_seal(site_path) == expected_site_sha256, "site source hash mismatch")
    site = json.loads(site_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    _need(site.get("case_id") == expected_case, "case identity mismatch")
    _need(site.get("map_sha256") and site.get("route_sha256"), "map/route source missing")
    _need(site.get("district_source_sha256"), "district source missing")
    boundary = site.get("intersection_boundary", {})
    _need(boundary.get("source_sha256") and len(boundary.get("polygon_xy_m", [])) >= 3,
          "intersection boundary source missing")
    _need(ticks == 900 and step_s == 0.05, "capture must be 900 ticks at 20 Hz")
    _need(ego.id != other.id, "participant identities collide")
    settings = world.get_settings()
    _need(settings.synchronous_mode and math.isclose(settings.fixed_delta_seconds, step_s,
          rel_tol=0, abs_tol=1e-9), "world must be synchronous at 20 Hz")
    road_map = world.get_map()
    _need(road_map.name == site.get("map_name"), "wrong live map")
    frames = []
    prior_frame = None
    prior_time = None
    try:
        for index in range(ticks):
            ego_control(ego, index)
            other_control(other, index)
            frame = world.tick()
            snapshot = world.get_snapshot()
            t = float(snapshot.timestamp.elapsed_seconds)
            _need(snapshot.frame == frame, "world tick/snapshot mismatch")
            if prior_frame is not None:
                _need(frame == prior_frame + 1, "noncontiguous original frame")
                _need(math.isclose(t - prior_time, step_s, rel_tol=0, abs_tol=1e-3),
                      "original tick interval mismatch")
            _need(math.isfinite(t), "nonfinite original time")
            if camera_collector is not None:
                camera_collector.read_frame(frame, t)
            frames.append({"frame": frame, "time_s": t,
                           "ego": _position(ego, road_map),
                           "other_vehicle": _position(other, road_map)})
            prior_frame, prior_time = frame, t
    finally:
        # A failed readback must not leave a vehicle under commanded throttle.
        for actor in (ego, other):
            brake_control(actor)
    packet = {
        "case_id": expected_case, "actor": "motor_vehicle_driver",
        "site_sha256": expected_site_sha256,
        "map_sha256": site["map_sha256"], "route_sha256": site["route_sha256"],
        "district_basis": {"source_sha256": site["district_source_sha256"]},
        "intersection_boundary": boundary,
        "ego_id": ego.id, "other_id": other.id,
        "frames": frames,
    }
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temporary = output.with_name(output.name + ".tmp")
    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(packet, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    try:
        if camera_collector is not None:
            camera_collector.finish(expected_case=expected_case,
                                    native_path=output, native_sha256=_seal(temporary),
                                    expected_frames=[s["frame"] for s in frames])
        temporary.replace(output)
    except Exception:
        temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        raise
    return {"path": str(output), "sha256": _seal(output), "frame_count": len(frames),
            "first_frame": frames[0]["frame"], "last_frame": frames[-1]["frame"]}

"""Independent saved audit of original U-turn camera PNGs and Native frames."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from PIL import Image

from capture_cameras import VIEWS


class SavedCameraError(ValueError):
    pass


def _need(ok, message):
    if not ok:
        raise SavedCameraError(message)


def _sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def audit(native_path: Path, native_sha256: str, manifest_path: Path,
          manifest_sha256: str, *, expected_case: str, expected_views=None,
          expected_count=900, strict_paths=None):
    """Hash and fully decode every retained original, with exact frame joins."""
    sizes = VIEWS if expected_views is None else expected_views
    if strict_paths is None:
        strict_paths = expected_count == 900
    _need(_sha(native_path) == native_sha256, "Native source hash mismatch")
    _need(_sha(manifest_path) == manifest_sha256, "camera manifest hash mismatch")
    native = json.loads(native_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    _need(native.get("case_id") == expected_case == manifest.get("case_id"),
          "case identity mismatch")
    _need(manifest.get("native_sha256") == native_sha256, "camera/Native source join mismatch")
    _need(len(native.get("frames", [])) == expected_count == manifest.get("frame_count"),
          "Native/camera frame count mismatch")
    _need(manifest.get("fps") == 20, "camera frame rate mismatch")
    _need(set(manifest.get("views", {})) == set(sizes), "camera view inventory mismatch")
    native_frames = [(row["frame"], row["time_s"]) for row in native["frames"]]
    _need(all(b[0] == a[0] + 1 and abs((b[1] - a[1]) - .05) <= .001
              for a, b in zip(native_frames, native_frames[1:])),
          "Native frame/time sequence invalid")
    evidence = {}
    for view, (width, height) in sizes.items():
        rows = manifest["views"][view]
        _need(len(rows) == expected_count, f"{view} original count mismatch")
        for (frame, time_s), row in zip(native_frames, rows):
            _need(row.get("frame") == frame and abs(row.get("time_s", -1) - time_s) <= .001,
                  f"{view} original frame/time join mismatch")
            path = Path(row["path"])
            if strict_paths and (path != manifest_path.parent / view / f"{frame:08d}.png" or
                                 not path.resolve().is_relative_to(manifest_path.parent.resolve())):
                raise SavedCameraError(f"{view} original path differs from attempt frame")
            _need(path.is_file() and path.suffix.lower() == ".png",
                  f"{view} original PNG missing")
            _need(_sha(path) == row.get("sha256"), f"{view} original hash mismatch")
            with Image.open(path) as image:
                _need(image.format == "PNG" and image.size == (width, height),
                      f"{view} original format/dimensions mismatch")
                image.load()
                _need(image.getbbox() is not None, f"{view} all-zero original pixels")
        evidence[view] = {"decoded_original_pngs": len(rows),
                          "first_frame": rows[0]["frame"],
                          "last_frame": rows[-1]["frame"]}
    return {"case_id": expected_case, "native_sha256": native_sha256,
            "camera_manifest_sha256": manifest_sha256,
            "source_decode": evidence, "physical_visibility": "unreviewed"}


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--native", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--native-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--camera-manifest", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--camera-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--case", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    result = audit(args.native, args.native_sha256, args.camera_manifest,
                   args.camera_sha256, expected_case=args.case)
    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Saved-only source audit for the three exact intersection U-turn cases.

The output measures recorded reversal and intersection occupancy without
deciding whether the district or intersection has the statutory classification.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from native_uturn import analyze_native
from saved_cameras import audit as audit_cameras


ASSIGNMENT = "testing__C111706__NRS-484B-403-3__motor_vehicle_driver"
CASES = {ASSIGNMENT + "__" + suffix for suffix in (
    "intersection_vehicle_near", "approach_before_intersection",
    "intersection_vehicle_far")}


def _sha(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def audit_saved(native_path: Path, camera_manifest: Path, site_path: Path,
                case_id: str, *, diagnostic: bool = False,
                expected_views=None) -> dict:
    """Require exact source joins and observed location separation.

    ``diagnostic`` permits only the three-frame small-camera CPU fixture.
    Original mode requires all 900 20 Hz frames and the capture profile.
    """
    if case_id not in CASES:
        raise ValueError("unknown exact U-turn case")
    native_path = Path(native_path)
    camera_manifest = Path(camera_manifest)
    site_path = Path(site_path)
    packet = json.loads(native_path.read_text())
    site = json.loads(site_path.read_text())
    if packet.get("case_id") != case_id or site.get("case_id") != case_id:
        raise ValueError("saved Native/site exact case differs")
    if packet.get("site_sha256") != _sha(site_path):
        raise ValueError("saved Native/site source binding differs")
    if (packet.get("map_sha256") != site.get("map_sha256") or
            packet.get("route_sha256") != site.get("route_sha256") or
            packet.get("district_basis", {}).get("source_sha256") != site.get("district_source_sha256") or
            packet.get("intersection_boundary") != site.get("intersection_boundary")):
        raise ValueError("saved Native reviewed map, route, district or boundary differs")
    if not diagnostic and site.get("source_kind") != "original_native_site_review":
        raise ValueError("original reviewed Native site required")
    measured = analyze_native(native_path, expected_case=case_id,
                              expected_sha256=_sha(native_path))
    count = 3 if diagnostic else 900
    if measured["frame_count"] != count:
        raise ValueError("exact 20 Hz source frame count differs")
    frames = packet["frames"]
    if any(abs(b["time_s"] - a["time_s"] - .05) > .001
           for a, b in zip(frames, frames[1:])):
        raise ValueError("original Native 20 Hz cadence differs")
    inside = bool(measured["whole_body_inside_intersection_frames"])
    expected_inside = not case_id.endswith("__approach_before_intersection")
    if inside != expected_inside:
        raise ValueError("measured U-turn location differs from exact case")
    camera = audit_cameras(native_path, _sha(native_path), camera_manifest,
                           _sha(camera_manifest), expected_case=case_id,
                           expected_count=count, expected_views=expected_views)
    if camera["native_sha256"] != measured["source_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("camera and motion audits use different Native source")
    return {"format": "c111706-saved-delivery-source-audit-v1",
            "case_id": case_id, "source_kind": site.get("source_kind", "diagnostic_fixture"),
            "site_sha256": _sha(site_path), "native_sha256": measured["source_sha256"],
            "camera_manifest_sha256": camera["camera_manifest_sha256"],
            "original_frame_count": count,
            "measured_reversal_deg": measured["reversal_deg"],
            "whole_body_inside_intersection_frames":
                measured["whole_body_inside_intersection_frames"],
            "minimum_other_vehicle_center_distance_m":
                measured["minimum_other_vehicle_center_distance_m"],
            "decoded_camera_sources": camera["source_decode"],
            "checks": {"native_source": not diagnostic,
                       "all_participants": True, "time_join": True,
                       "full_video_decode": False, "actual_pixels": False,
                       "physical_completion": False},
            "district_classification": "unresolved_review",
            "physical_acceptance": "not_assessed",
            "legal_judgment": "unresolved"}


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--native", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--camera-manifest", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--site", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--case", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--diagnostic", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    print(json.dumps(audit_saved(args.native, args.camera_manifest, args.site,
                                  args.case, diagnostic=args.diagnostic), sort_keys=True))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Source-bound checks for an NRS 484B.403(3) U-turn capture.

This module consumes original Native map/actor samples. It does not decide
whether a district is legally a business district or issue a legal verdict.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import math
import argparse
from pathlib import Path


class SourceError(ValueError):
    pass


def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def _require(condition: bool, reason: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise SourceError(reason)


def _angle_difference(a: float, b: float) -> float:
    return abs((a - b + 180.0) % 360.0 - 180.0)


def _inside_polygon(x: float, y: float, polygon: list[list[float]]) -> bool:
    """Ray-crossing test for the recorded intersection polygon in map XY."""
    inside = False
    for i, (ax, ay) in enumerate(polygon):
        bx, by = polygon[i - 1]
        if (ay > y) != (by > y):
            x_cross = ax + (y - ay) * (bx - ax) / (by - ay)
            if x < x_cross:
                inside = not inside
    return inside


def analyze_native(path: Path, *, expected_case: str, expected_sha256: str) -> dict:
    """Check recorded route/participant sources and return measurements.

    The input is a compact, hash-sealed projection of original Native packets.
    ``district_basis`` must cite an independently reviewed source; this check
    intentionally leaves district classification unresolved.
    """
    _require(sha256(path) == expected_sha256, "Native source hash mismatch")
    packet = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    _require(packet.get("case_id") == expected_case, "case identity mismatch")
    _require(packet.get("actor") == "motor_vehicle_driver", "actor identity mismatch")
    _require(packet.get("map_sha256") and packet.get("route_sha256"), "map/route source binding missing")
    _require(packet.get("district_basis", {}).get("source_sha256"), "district source binding missing")
    boundary = packet.get("intersection_boundary", {})
    polygon = boundary.get("polygon_xy_m", [])
    _require(boundary.get("source_sha256") and len(polygon) >= 3, "intersection boundary source missing")
    _require(all(len(point) == 2 and all(math.isfinite(float(v)) for v in point)
                 for point in polygon), "invalid intersection polygon")
    samples = packet.get("frames", [])
    _require(len(samples) >= 3, "insufficient original frames")
    first = samples[0]["frame"]
    prev_time = -math.inf
    for i, sample in enumerate(samples):
        _require(sample["frame"] == first + i, "noncontiguous original frame map")
        t = sample["time_s"]
        _require(isinstance(t, (int, float)) and math.isfinite(t) and t > prev_time, "invalid original time sequence")
        prev_time = t
        ego = sample.get("ego", {})
        other = sample.get("other_vehicle", {})
        _require(ego.get("id") == packet.get("ego_id"), "ego source identity mismatch")
        _require(other.get("id") == packet.get("other_id"), "other vehicle source identity mismatch")
        _require(ego.get("road_id") is not None and ego.get("lane_id") is not None, "ego map lane missing")
        _require(other.get("road_id") is not None and other.get("lane_id") is not None, "other vehicle map lane missing")
        _require(all(math.isfinite(float(ego[k])) for k in ("x", "y", "yaw_deg")), "invalid ego pose")
        _require(all(math.isfinite(float(other[k])) for k in ("x", "y")), "invalid other vehicle pose")
        corners = ego.get("body_corners_xy_m", [])
        _require(len(corners) >= 4, "ego body footprint missing")
        _require(all(len(point) == 2 and all(math.isfinite(float(v)) for v in point)
                     for point in corners), "invalid ego body footprint")
    start, end = samples[0]["ego"], samples[-1]["ego"]
    _require(start["road_id"] == end["road_id"], "U-turn road continuity missing")
    _require(start["lane_id"] != end["lane_id"], "opposite destination lane missing")
    _require(_angle_difference(start["yaw_deg"], end["yaw_deg"]) >= 135.0, "full reversal not observed")
    junction_frames = [s["frame"] for s in samples if s["ego"].get("junction_id") is not None]
    whole_body_inside_frames = [s["frame"] for s in samples if all(
        _inside_polygon(x, y, polygon) for x, y in s["ego"]["body_corners_xy_m"])]
    distances = [math.hypot(s["ego"]["x"] - s["other_vehicle"]["x"],
                            s["ego"]["y"] - s["other_vehicle"]["y"]) for s in samples]
    return {
        "case_id": expected_case,
        "source_sha256": expected_sha256,
        "frame_count": len(samples),
        "start_frame": first,
        "end_frame": samples[-1]["frame"],
        "reversal_deg": _angle_difference(start["yaw_deg"], end["yaw_deg"]),
        "junction_frames": junction_frames,
        "junction_occupied_during_reversal": bool(junction_frames),
        "whole_body_inside_intersection_frames": whole_body_inside_frames,
        "intersection_boundary_source_sha256": boundary["source_sha256"],
        "minimum_other_vehicle_center_distance_m": min(distances),
        "district_source_sha256": packet["district_basis"]["source_sha256"],
        "district_classification": "unresolved_review",
    }


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Audit sealed original Native U-turn packets")
    parser.add_argument("--native", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--case", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    result = analyze_native(args.native, expected_case=args.case, expected_sha256=args.sha256)
    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Independent source-bound comparison checks for the two planned U-turn pairs."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from native_uturn import analyze_native


class ComparisonError(ValueError):
    pass


ASSIGNMENT = "testing__C111706__NRS-484B-403-3__motor_vehicle_driver"
PAIRS = {
    "intersection_exception_location": frozenset((
        ASSIGNMENT + "__intersection_vehicle_near",
        ASSIGNMENT + "__approach_before_intersection")),
    "surrounding_vehicle_context": frozenset((
        ASSIGNMENT + "__intersection_vehicle_near",
        ASSIGNMENT + "__intersection_vehicle_far")),
}


def _need(ok, reason):
    if not ok:
        raise ComparisonError(reason)


def _read(path, expected_sha):
    _need(hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected_sha,
          "comparison source hash mismatch")
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def compare(comparison_id: str, left_site: Path, left_site_sha: str,
            left_native: Path, left_native_sha: str, right_site: Path,
            right_site_sha: str, right_native: Path, right_native_sha: str):
    """Compare sealed authored setup and measured original Native outcomes.

    No physical success or legal classification is inferred from the case name.
    Requiring completed site fields means an unsurveyed draft cannot pass.
    """
    _need(comparison_id in PAIRS,
          "unknown comparison")
    left = _read(left_site, left_site_sha)
    right = _read(right_site, right_site_sha)
    _need(frozenset((left.get("case_id"), right.get("case_id"))) == PAIRS[comparison_id],
          "exact comparison case pair differs")
    for site, site_sha, native_path, native_sha in (
            (left, left_site_sha, left_native, left_native_sha),
            (right, right_site_sha, right_native, right_native_sha)):
        packet = _read(native_path, native_sha)
        _need(packet.get("site_sha256") == site_sha and
              packet.get("map_sha256") == site.get("map_sha256") and
              packet.get("route_sha256") == site.get("route_sha256"),
              "Native site/map/route source binding differs")
    left_result = analyze_native(left_native, expected_case=left["case_id"],
                                 expected_sha256=left_native_sha)
    right_result = analyze_native(right_native, expected_case=right["case_id"],
                                  expected_sha256=right_native_sha)
    _need(left["case_id"] != right["case_id"], "comparison cases must differ")
    _need(left_result["frame_count"] == right_result["frame_count"] == 900,
          "comparison requires complete 900-frame sources")
    common = ("map_sha256", "district_source_sha256", "intersection_boundary_source_sha256",
              "ego_blueprint", "other_blueprint", "weather_sha256", "camera_policy_sha256",
              "other_route_sha256")
    for key in common:
        _need(left.get(key) and left.get(key) == right.get(key),
              f"fixed comparison source differs: {key}")
    _need(left_result["district_source_sha256"] == right_result["district_source_sha256"] ==
          left["district_source_sha256"], "Native district/source mismatch")
    _need(left_result["intersection_boundary_source_sha256"] ==
          right_result["intersection_boundary_source_sha256"] ==
          left["intersection_boundary_source_sha256"], "Native boundary/source mismatch")
    if comparison_id == "intersection_exception_location":
        _need(left.get("other_start_tick") == right.get("other_start_tick") is not None,
              "other-vehicle timing changed")
        _need(left.get("ego_route_sha256") and right.get("ego_route_sha256") and
              left["ego_route_sha256"] != right["ego_route_sha256"],
              "ego path difference missing")
        _need(bool(left_result["whole_body_inside_intersection_frames"]) !=
              bool(right_result["whole_body_inside_intersection_frames"]),
              "original intersection footprint distinction missing")
    else:
        _need(left.get("ego_route_sha256") and
              left["ego_route_sha256"] == right.get("ego_route_sha256"),
              "ego path changed in surrounding-vehicle pair")
        _need(isinstance(left.get("other_start_tick"), int) and
              isinstance(right.get("other_start_tick"), int) and
              left["other_start_tick"] != right["other_start_tick"],
              "other-vehicle timing difference missing")
    return {"comparison_id": comparison_id, "left_case": left["case_id"],
            "right_case": right["case_id"],
            "left_native_sha256": left_native_sha, "right_native_sha256": right_native_sha,
            "fixed_sources_checked": list(common),
            "observed_whole_body_inside_intersection_frames": [
                len(left_result["whole_body_inside_intersection_frames"]),
                len(right_result["whole_body_inside_intersection_frames"])],
            "observed_minimum_other_vehicle_center_distance_m": [
                left_result["minimum_other_vehicle_center_distance_m"],
                right_result["minimum_other_vehicle_center_distance_m"]],
            "legal_interpretation": "unresolved_review"}


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--comparison", required=True)
    for side in ("left", "right"):
        parser.add_argument(f"--{side}-site", type=Path, required=True)
        parser.add_argument(f"--{side}-site-sha256", required=True)
        parser.add_argument(f"--{side}-native", type=Path, required=True)
        parser.add_argument(f"--{side}-native-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    result = compare(args.comparison, args.left_site, args.left_site_sha256,
                     args.left_native, args.left_native_sha256,
                     args.right_site, args.right_site_sha256,
                     args.right_native, args.right_native_sha256)
